about: The entry screen's distribution as the old path answers it. Recorded from the code before the figure service, which is gone: the file cannot be made again, and stays as the record of what that code answered.
boundary_note: A value exactly on a bin edge is counted in the higher bin (binCounts: floor((value − low) / width); where the edge in floating point is just above the value, as 62.5 here, in the lower), and a click off any point at that value picks the higher bin; the pointer exactly between two bar tops reads the lower bar (nearestPoint keeps the first on a tie); a picked bin is closed at both ends, so a value on its high edge is in the range and kept by the table, yet counted in the next bin.

layout.description: What is laid out of scene plain: No range picked; slot 1 is a recording of B, slot 2 one of A; the base is the median of A (given as 50).
layout.source: old path: distribution.ts distribution / binCounts; entryDistribution.ts distributionRows

layout.description: What is laid out of scene picked: The range picked is bin 11 of the axis (11 × 100/48 … 25), as a click on that bar picks it: closed at both ends, so the two recordings at exactly 25 are in it.
layout.source: old path: distribution.ts distribution / binCounts; entryDistribution.ts distributionRows

layout.description: What is laid out of scene slot0: Slot 0 holds a recording (the base is a file, no median line).
layout.source: old path: distribution.ts distribution / binCounts; entryDistribution.ts distributionRows

read.description: On the top of A's bar of bin 12 (its centre, count 3): that bar is read, both ends of its bin and its count; a click picks its bin.
read.source: old path: entryDistributionPane.ts (plotHoverLayer, stagePanes.stageHover / fullLineNear, plotHover.nearestPoint, clickOnRead, entryDistribution.distributionClick)

read.description: Exactly on the edge between bins 11 and 12 (value 25), at bin 12's height: bin 11 is empty (no bar), so bin 12's bar is read.
read.source: old path: entryDistributionPane.ts (plotHoverLayer, stagePanes.stageHover / fullLineNear, plotHover.nearestPoint, clickOnRead, entryDistribution.distributionClick)

read.description: Exactly on the edge between bins 28 (60: count 1) and 29 (62.5: count 1; 30 × 100/48 is 62.50000000000001 in floating point, so 62.5 is counted under that edge, in bin 29), at their height: as near to each bar top, the lower bar (28) is read, the first in the data's order.
read.source: old path: entryDistributionPane.ts (plotHoverLayer, stagePanes.stageHover / fullLineNear, plotHover.nearestPoint, clickOnRead, entryDistribution.distributionClick)

read.description: Above A's bar of bin 12 at value 25 exactly, out of the pick radius of every bar top and rug tick: the bar under the pointer across is read (the point under the pointer, R7), bin 12; a click picks its bin.
read.source: old path: entryDistributionPane.ts (plotHoverLayer, stagePanes.stageHover / fullLineNear, plotHover.nearestPoint, clickOnRead, entryDistribution.distributionClick)

read.description: Over A's empty bin 20 (no bar, no rug tick near) out of the pick radius of everything: an empty bin has no bar to read, so the nearest bar across (bin 18, of 37.5) is read, and a click picks that bar's bin, not the bin under the pointer.
read.source: old path: entryDistributionPane.ts (plotHoverLayer, stagePanes.stageHover / fullLineNear, plotHover.nearestPoint, clickOnRead, entryDistribution.distributionClick)
